reason: A web-panel observability plugin that reads DeepSeek Harness session logs to visualize multi-agent activity, relationships, usage, failures, historical replays, and Markdown reports.

summaries.zh: 通过读取 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志，在网页面板中可视化多智能体活动、委派关系、成本、失败、历史回放并导出 Markdown 复盘报告。
summaries.en: A web-panel observability plugin that reads DeepSeek Harness session logs to visualize multi-agent activity, delegation relationships, costs, failures, historical replays, and Markdown reports.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek Harness session logs from local storage
Visualizes agent relationships, timelines, costs, failures, approvals, context usage, and tool activity
Replays historical sessions in a web panel
Exports session analyses as Markdown reports
